thesis: The Rack converts an empty opposing hand into recurring damage, reversing Black Vise by rewarding discard rather than punishing card accumulation.

canonicalIdentity.originalPrintedText: As this artifact enters, choose an opponent. At the beginning of the chosen player's upkeep, this artifact deals X damage to that player, where X is 3 minus the number of cards in their hand.
